Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect into the breeding area, does that [On Play] effect trigger?

Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [CS] trait, gain 1 memory.

[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer and returning 1 of your Digimon with the [Hudie] trait to the hand, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [CS] trait from your hand to your empty breeding area without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is [Hudiemon], [Eater Legion] or [Eater EDEN], it gains ＜Alliance＞.
